Pursuant to Regulation 39(4) read with Schedule VI of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, listed companies are required to transfer all unclaimed shares to a single folio in the name of the Company's Unclaimed Suspense Account.

Accordingly, Info Edge (India) Limited has opened an account in the name of Info Edge (India) Limited – Unclaimed Suspense Account. In compliance with the aforesaid provisions, 11 (eleven) share certificates pertaining to 11 (eleven) folios, representing 655 (six hundred fifty-five) equity shares of face value Rs.2/- (Rupees Two only) each, which were returned undelivered during the dispatch of share certificates issued pursuant to the sub-division (split) of equity shares, have been transferred to the aforesaid Unclaimed Suspense Account and dematerialized in accordance with the applicable regulatory requirements.
